@@ -0,0 +1,15 @@
+# Taskboard CLI
+
+A dependency-free task manager for Bun. Data is stored in `.taskboard.json` in
+the working directory, or at the path specified by `TASKBOARD_FILE`.
+
+```sh
+bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Write release notes" --tags docs,release --due 2026-09-10
+bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag docs
+bun run src/cli.ts done 1
+bun run src/cli.ts stats
+bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
+```
+
+All successful commands print one JSON value to standard output. Errors are
+written to standard error and exit non-zero.

1: type Status = "open" | "done";
2: 
3: type Task = {
4:   id: number;
5:   title: string;
6:   tags: string[];
7:   status: Status;
8:   createdAt: string;
9:   due?: string;
10:   completedAt?: string;
11: };
12: 
13: type Database = { tasks: Task[]; nextId: number };
14: 
15: const file = Bun.env.TASKBOARD_FILE || `${process.cwd()}/.taskboard.json`;
16: 
17: function fail(message: string): never {
18:   console.error(message);
19:   process.exit(1);
20: }
21: 
22: function isDate(value: string): boolean {
23:   if (!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) return false;
24:   const [year, month, day] = value.split("-").map(Number);
25:   const date = new Date(year, month - 1, day);
26:   return date.getFullYear() === year && date.getMonth() === month - 1 && date.getDate() === day;
27: }
28: 
29: function today(): string {
30:   const now = new Date();
31:   const offset = now.getTimezoneOffset() * 60_000;
32:   return new Date(now.getTime() - offset).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
33: }
34: 
35: function load(): Database {
36:   if (!Bun.file(file).size) return { tasks: [], nextId: 1 };
37:   let value: unknown;
38:   try {
39:     value = JSON.parse(Bun.file(file).text ? "" : "");
40:   } catch {
41:     // Re-read synchronously below because Bun.file().text() is asynchronous.
42:   }
43:   try {
44:     value = JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
45:   } catch {
46:     fail("Malformed taskboard database");
47:   }
48:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") fail("Malformed taskboard database");
49:   const db = value as Partial<Database>;
50:   if (!Array.isArray(db.tasks) || !Number.isSafeInteger(db.nextId) || db.nextId < 1) {
51:     fail("Malformed taskboard database");
52:   }
53:   for (const task of db.tasks) {
54:     if (!task || !Number.isSafeInteger(task.id) || typeof task.title !== "string" ||
55:       !Array.isArray(task.tags) || (task.status !== "open" && task.status !== "done") ||
56:       typeof task.createdAt !== "string" || (task.due !== undefined && !isDate(task.due))) {
57:       fail("Malformed taskboard database");
58:     }
59:   }
60:   return db as Database;
61: }
62: 
63: function save(db: Database): void {
64:   const temp = `${file}.${process.pid}.${Date.now()}.tmp`;
65:   try {
66:     require("fs").writeFileSync(temp, `${JSON.stringify(db, null, 2)}\n`);
67:     require("fs").renameSync(temp, file);
68:   } catch {
69:     try { require("fs").unlinkSync(temp); } catch {}
70:     fail("Unable to write taskboard database");
71:   }
72: }
73: 
74: function options(args: string[], allowed: string[]): Record<string, string> {
75:   const result: Record<string, string> = {};
76:   for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index += 2) {
77:     const flag = args[index];
78:     const value = args[index + 1];
79:     if (!allowed.includes(flag) || value === undefined || result[flag] !== undefined) fail("Invalid command arguments");
80:     result[flag] = value;
81:   }
82:   return result;
83: }
84: 
85: function taskId(value: string | undefined): number {
86:   if (!value || !/^\d+$/.test(value)) fail("Task ID must be a positive integer");
87:   const id = Number(value);
88:   if (!Number.isSafeInteger(id) || id < 1) fail("Task ID must be a positive integer");
89:   return id;
90: }
91: 
92: const [command, ...args] = Bun.argv.slice(2);
93: let output: unknown;
94: 
95: switch (command) {
96:   case "add": {
97:     const opts = options(args, ["--title", "--tags", "--due"]);
98:     const title = opts["--title"]?.trim();
99:     if (!title) fail("Title must not be empty");
100:     if (opts["--due"] && !isDate(opts["--due"])) fail("Due date must be YYYY-MM-DD");
101:     const tags = [...new Set((opts["--tags"] || "").split(",").map(tag => tag.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))];
102:     const db = load();
103:     const task: Task = { id: db.nextId++, title, tags, status: "open", createdAt: new Date().toISOString() };
104:     if (opts["--due"]) task.due = opts["--due"];
105:     db.tasks.push(task);
106:     save(db);
107:     output = task;
108:     break;
109:   }
110:   case "list": {
111:     const opts = options(args, ["--status", "--tag", "--overdue"]);
112:     if (opts["--status"] && opts["--status"] !== "open" && opts["--status"] !== "done") fail("Status must be open or done");
113:     if (opts["--overdue"] && !isDate(opts["--overdue"])) fail("Overdue date must be YYYY-MM-DD");
114:     output = load().tasks.filter(task =>
115:       (!opts["--status"] || task.status === opts["--status"]) &&
116:       (!opts["--tag"] || task.tags.includes(opts["--tag"].trim().toLowerCase())) &&
117:       (!opts["--overdue"] || (task.status === "open" && !!task.due && task.due < opts["--overdue"]))
118:     ).sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
119:     break;
120:   }
121:   case "done": {
122:     if (args.length !== 1) fail("Usage: done ID");
123:     const db = load();
124:     const task = db.tasks.find(item => item.id === taskId(args[0]));
125:     if (!task) fail("Task not found");
126:     if (task.status === "open") {
127:       task.status = "done";
128:       task.completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
129:       save(db);
130:     }
131:     output = task;
132:     break;
133:   }
134:   case "delete": {
135:     if (args.length !== 1) fail("Usage: delete ID");
136:     const db = load();
137:     const id = taskId(args[0]);
138:     const index = db.tasks.findIndex(task => task.id === id);
139:     if (index < 0) fail("Task not found");
140:     const [task] = db.tasks.splice(index, 1);
141:     save(db);
142:     output = task;
143:     break;
144:   }
145:   case "stats": {
146:     if (args.length) fail("Usage: stats");
147:     const tasks = load().tasks;
148:     output = {
149:       total: tasks.length,
150:       open: tasks.filter(task => task.status === "open").length,
151:       done: tasks.filter(task => task.status === "done").length,
152:       overdue: tasks.filter(task => task.status === "open" && !!task.due && task.due < today()).length,
153:     };
154:     break;
155:   }
156:   default:
157:     fail("Unknown command");
158: }
159: 
160: console.log(JSON.stringify(output));
